home.title: Pano
home.headline: Feedback boards and a public roadmap
home.intro: People post what they need and vote on what matters. Your team answers in the open, moves requests across the roadmap, and tells everyone the moment something ships.
home.demoNote: The demo is Inkwell, a made-up notes app. You get your own guest account, and everything resets each night.
home.ownBoard: Ideas for Pano itself go on <link>Pano's own board</link>.
home.signInCta: Sign in to start your own board
home.votesBody: Fifty people voting at the same moment still leave the count equal to the votes. Click as fast as you like: it ends the way your last click left it.
home.instantTitle: Instant, and honest when it fails
home.instantBody: Votes, moves and comments show the moment you act. If the server says no, everything goes back, with a message that says why.
home.duplicatesBody: While someone types a title, the five closest requests appear. The team merges the rest, and a person who voted on both counts once.
home.languagesBody: Every screen and email in both languages. Search folds Turkish letters, so “isler” finds “işler”.
